replayOracle.parentFinalCompositeAuthorship: The eight CR6 final-composite PNG controls are CPU-authored by the CR6 harness; the CR6 GPU result is an independent parity replay only.
replayOracle.cpuQ1Control: The independent binary64 CPU q=1 replay must reproduce every decoded parent final-composite PNG RGB code exactly.
